description: Set up the development groundwork without touching the live forms: an offline check suite, guards that block live changes without approval, and documentation. Built the automatic sheet-to-form sync, and a searchable club dropdown on the template form so mentors pick their club instead of typing its exact spelling.

Finished the code cleanup and the fixes found in review. Assigned regions to new clubs missing one, synced the new club submissions to the Jotform forms, and audited the sheet and every form to confirm each club landed correctly. Got the automatic sheet-to-form sync working end to end and started a required region picker on the Club Roster Form.

Completed and reviewed the required region picker on the Club Roster Form so new partners choose their region (not yet live). Started a review of all open work items and overall system health, changing nothing live, to plan the upcoming mass form update.
Delivered a roadmap of all open work items and audit findings, covering where the system stands and the decisions that need leadership approval. Began planning the quick wins that need no approval.

Rolled out the searchable club dropdown to all attendance forms with leadership's new wording and translations (including Odia), raised the photo upload limit to 10 MB with HEIC accepted, and switched automatic roster syncing to live. Resolved one club's duplicate roster, confirmed a delayed new club now appears, and ran two system health checks.

Corrected a mis-entered club name for an Asia partner club on the master enrollment sheet, the Asia attendance form and the template form. The club kept its code, records and roster, and the result was checked afterwards. Also built a reusable tool so future club renames can be done the same safe way.

Added Hindi and Persian translations, with their flags, to the Asia attendance form. Built an Odia flag for the language menu on every form, since Jotform has none, and fixed a display problem so it appears on the live pages. Checked the Urdu and Arabic translations already on the Asia form and filled the one gap found.

Prepared the new Global Catalyst logo at the right size for the attendance-form headers. Investigated the broken language menus on the Africa, Asia and Latin America forms and traced them to a script error in Jotform's page code. Built a correction, not yet applied, so Fundación Kaleidos can see Club Glow Traslasierra when adding girls.

Confirmed the language menus work again on all attendance forms; the outage was a temporary Jotform bug and no form changes were needed. Took the club-move correction through two rounds of review, adding safety checks and tests; nothing was changed live.

Prepared a fix for the Swahili Submit button on the attendance forms (not yet live). Finalized the club-move correction and set out the steps to apply it. Began reviewing the 11 submitted problem reports and confirmed the automatic roster sync was working correctly.

Completed the review of all 11 open problem reports: none were fixed by recent work, and one club's earlier roster fix had been undone. Built, tested and reviewed a fix so the "Process any missed form responses" menu previews and asks before running, and never re-applies old submissions, even after a time-zone change (not yet live).

Put live the fix that stops old roster submissions being re-applied, and restored the Radiant Girls roster fix on the Africa form. Added Swahili "Submit" to all forms and moved Club Glow Traslasierra to Fundación Kaleidos. Routed roster-change problem reports to the review queue and Monday e-mail; started on the remaining reports and this work log.
